title: Baseline conditions held fixed in every DELPHI simulation (flight, physiology, growth, design studio)
decided_by: project lead (Amit): nutrients, heat, sleep, clearance etc. held at average levels for now
rule: Simulations and the design studio never vary these. A design edit changes morphology, physiology parameters or genotype only. Each module reads its environment from this file (or must state the same values) and shows them as locked in its parameter panel.

water_temperature_C.note: warm surface water; matches the default in physiology/index.js; body temperature taken equal to water temperature (ectotherm)

water_O2.note: numeric value comes from physiology/ (sourced there) at the temperature and salinity here

air_density_kg_m3.note: standard sea-level air; the value the Lean audit uses

nutrition.note: no feeding cycle, no starvation or surplus; growth curves are field fits, which already embed average field nutrition

activity_rest_sleep.note: no rest or sleep cycle; metabolism at the routine level outside modelled locomotion bouts

clearance.note: waste, CO2 and lactate clearance at baseline; only the burst-recovery time constant in physiology/index.js is modelled, at its default

acid_base_CO2_pH.note: not modelled; no Root/Bohr shift beyond physiology/ defaults

wind_waves.note: still air over a flat surface, except where the flight simulator uses Park and Choi's measured ground effect
